title: [P4-E] Temporary root dependency exception for upstream-blocked selector parser
body:
PARENT_CONTRACT=#99 / RM-05
PROPOSED_PHASE=P4_AUTHORIZED_PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT
PRIORITY=P1
WORKSTREAM=E

## Scope

Track the exact Owner review of upstream-blocked root audit advisory GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf for postcss-selector-parser. Keep this decision separate from T1, C1, and existing Issue #122. This issue records a proposal only; no exception has been approved or applied.

The only Owner decision currently granted is comment [#6010603282](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/issues/135#issuecomment-6010603282). It authorizes engineering work only, is bound to the earlier source state, and explicitly sets `EXCEPTION_CONSUMPTION_AUTHORIZATION=NO` and `MERGE_AUTHORIZATION=NO`.

## Superseded source binding

The previous candidate, policy, review, and evidence digests in the older proposal are superseded by evaluator and CI changes. The old Owner decision remains valid only as permission to continue engineering; it does not approve the new evaluator, consume R3, or authorize a merge. A corrected candidate and independent reviews are pending. No old digest or expiry will be reused.

## Exact R3 dependency state

The fresh root audit reports `GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf` for `postcss-selector-parser` at moderate severity. The installed graph contains these eight version/path pairs:

- `6.0.10` — `apps__site>@tailwindcss/typography>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>@expressive-code/plugin-collapsible-sections>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>@expressive-code/plugin-line-numbers>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>astro-expressive-code>rehype-expressive-code>expressive-code>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>astro-expressive-code>rehype-expressive-code>expressive-code>@expressive-code/plugin-frames>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>astro-expressive-code>rehype-expressive-code>expressive-code>@expressive-code/plugin-shiki>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`
- `6.1.4` — `apps__site>astro-expressive-code>rehype-expressive-code>expressive-code>@expressive-code/plugin-text-markers>@expressive-code/core>postcss-nested>postcss-selector-parser`

The raw audit remains authoritative evidence and must continue to execute unchanged. The policy does not suppress R3 or absorb any other moderate/high/critical finding.

## Fresh upstream check

Checked 2026-10-06. Upstream parser 7.1.6 fixes R3, but the supported parents do not yet expose that version: Tailwind Typography 0.5.20 pins parser 6.0.10 exactly; Expressive Code core 0.44.2 allows postcss-nested `^6.0.1`, whose latest compatible 6.x line still resolves parser 6.1.4. postcss-nested 8 is a major parent change and targets parser 7.x, so no supported compatible parent update clears all paths. A separate low-severity CVE-2026-9358 affects parser versions `>=6.1.0 <6.1.3` and `>=7.1.0 <7.1.3`; the installed 6.1.4 and 6.0.10 are outside those ranges.

## Evaluator and review state

The corrected evaluator now consumes the complete pnpm 9 raw audit, frozen-lockfile install evidence, and recursive workspace dependency tree. It validates exact nested schemas, versions, complete dependency paths, audit action resolutions, the separate #122 supplemental audit, current PR #133 SHAs, and the open #135 contract. Unknown, malformed, changed, additional, or unapproved qualifying findings fail closed.

The current PR-controlled workflow is useful candidate evidence but is not a trusted authorization gate: the PR can modify its own workflow/evaluator, and no protected-base verifier or repository ruleset anchoring this check has been observed. Independent final code and security reviews are pending. Exception consumption remains unauthorized regardless of the CI outcome.

## Other gates and current state

- #99 remains Blocked.
- #135 is In Progress while implementation and independent reviews are completed.
- #129 and #130 retain their existing states.
- T1's old candidate remains superseded; no new T1 manifest or approval is generated here.
- C1 remains `INCOMPLETE_OWNER_SETUP_REQUIRED`.
- #122 remains unchanged and independently scoped.
- PR #133 remains open and unmerged. No Production action, release, P5, or Edge Gateway work is authorized or performed.

After the candidate is frozen and reviews finish, the new evidence package will record its exact hashes and review dispositions. It will not self-approve or request exception consumption unless every engineering and security gate is ready.

PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION=NO
MERGE_AUTHORIZATION=NO
EXCEPTION_CONSUMPTION_AUTHORIZATION=NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION_PERFORMED=NO

## PR #136 trust-root bootstrap progress — 2026-10-08

Engineering work continues on the existing draft [PR #136](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/pull/136), now at `0d8525249803e3f51d4b056a3552b4d7fe99fd33`, based on unchanged `main` `c79659046cf6ea73ba69e03c3937d904c07ba93b`. Normal compatible dependency remediation resolves source-map-js only to 1.2.2 and smol-toml only to 1.9.0, with the obsolete smol-toml 1.8.0 override removed. Recursive installed-tree and lock traversal evidence preserve the exact eight R3 routes and separate #122 routes. #122's issue, scope, policy, and existing ignore remain unchanged.

Fresh raw `pnpm audit --audit-level moderate` and JSON both exit 1. The only otherwise unapproved moderate/high/critical advisory is R3, `GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf`, at parser 6.0.10/6.1.4. Low findings remain reported. The raw metadata retains 4 low, 2 moderate, and 1 high affected-version findings; the high finding belongs only to the separate existing #122 exception and its advisory is excluded by that existing configuration. No R3 suppression or global bypass was added.

Pinned-pnpm verifier compatibility fixes validate per-version severity counts, omitted optional flags, and empty paths in uninstalled audit workspaces while independently enforcing exact lock topology. The isolated verifier audits the whole sanitized workspace. Local focused tests pass 118/118; full build/type/site/edge/release/QA checks and minimal/full/migrated browser fixtures pass. The Linux nobody-user credential boundary remains a workflow contract pending separately authorized live setup.

At this progress update, exact-head GitHub CI and new independent code/security reviews are pending. Prior reviews are historical after these source/lock changes. The latest Owner engineering direction permits preparing a narrowly hash-bound, one-time bootstrap merge proposal with raw audit honestly FAIL if R3 is the only residual unapproved qualifying blocker. This does not approve merging, consume R3, rebind PR #133, or authorize App/Environment/secrets/ruleset/Production. The proposed Owner decision will remain local and unposted.

`NORMAL_CI_MERGE_READY=NO`; one-time bootstrap review readiness remains conditional on exact-head CI and both fresh independent reviews. All three authorization fields above remain NO.

Additional independent review repairs preserve PENDING technical evidence while failing the required App check, reject unknown workspace manifests, and require Issue #135 open on each selected-decision read. #122's actual before/after issue body is identical; only its previously stale verifier digest binding was corrected. The inert ruleset remains not apply-ready pending separately reviewed continuing expiry/revocation enforcement; no live setup or consumption is authorized.

Final review repairs also protect root/fixed-importer package-manager config/hooks and bind/revalidate separate #122 state/title/body before App eligibility, publication, and completion. No existing exception scope or issue body was changed. Raw audit remains FAIL; all authorization fields remain NO.
